blind.description: No text or labels are visible in any of the images. The model is a tall, free-standing architectural stone pillar (column) with a raven perched on top. It features a stepped square plinth base, a central vertical column shaft decorated with recessed Gothic arches and a relief-carved hourglass motif, a flared capital with draped shroud-like carvings, and a flat square top platform. Perched in the center of the top platform is a solid black sculpted raven with folded wings. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and watertight, with no broken shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or thin floating flakes. Nothing hovers unattached, and there is no melted or fused geometry. The column stands firmly on its own integrated stepped square base plinth, whose underside sits flat on the floor with no added ground slab or plinth. Materials and colors consist of hand-painted stylized stonework in warm ivory and beige tones, accented with ink-black paint in the decorative recesses and a solid matte black finish on the raven. There are no raw unpainted areas, and no flame or glow.
blind.from_above: From straight above (tile C), the model displays the square flat surface of the pillar capital framing the dorsal view of the sculpted black raven in the center. The raven's pointed beak extends forward toward the bottom edge, flanked by rounded wings and tapering back to tail feathers pointing toward the top edge. The light beige square capital surrounds the bird, with dark brackets or corbels protruding from the center of each of the four sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: The model is approximately 10 feet tall (about 1.7 to 1.8 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, extending well above its head). The square base and capital are approximately 3.3 feet wide (about 0.6 times the height of the figure, spanning roughly two-thirds of a 5-foot floor grid square).
